title: 대외경제협력기금법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00342:20130323:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 342, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Rules) (1) through (7) Omitted.

(8) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Economic Development Cooperation Fund Act shall be amended as follows:
In the portions of Article 2 (1) outside the subparagraphs and Article 3 other than the subparagraphs thereof, "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade" shall be replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs".

(9) through (15) Omitted.
